gradient_descent_fit_is_the_nearest_fit: One chew ends at the fit of its batch nearest to where it started. This makes a chew a projection, which is the whole argument.
gradient_descent_stays_in_the_directions: A chew moves only along the features of its batch. Directions the batch does not see are left alone.
moving_along_the_features_is_moving_leas: The step behind the two rows below it.
forgetting_is_at_most_predict_size_times: A ceiling on what one chew undoes on an earlier batch: the size of the old predictor times the travel of the chew.
The same ceiling for a chew that is stopped early.
forgetting_goes_through_the_cross_kernel: Each step of a chew changes old errors only through the kernel between the two batches.
separate_features_forget_nothing: If two batches share no features, chewing one leaves the other exactly as it was, for any number of steps.
forgetting_along_one_direction: The forgetting of one step, along one direction of the cross kernel.
two_small_steps_against_one_big_step: Says where the order of steps matters: the difference passes through the kernel between the batches. Chewing changes only the order of steps.
two_small_steps_equal_one_big_step_for_s: For batches that share nothing the order does not matter, so chewing equals plain SGD with the same number of steps.
linear_scaling_rule: About batch size against learning rate. The method changes neither.
gradient_step_changes_residual_by_the_ke: Each step of a chew multiplies the batch's error by the same kernel, so a chew of k steps is the k-th power of one map.
one_step_shrinks_one_direction: One more step on the same batch shrinks the error along a direction by a fixed factor. So the returns from a chew fall geometrically.
each_direction_runs_on_its_own_clock: Weak directions of a batch take many more steps than strong ones. This is why 'until convergence' needs a cap.
strong_directions_first: A chew that is stopped early has fitted the strong directions of its batch and left the weak ones.
direction_of_zero_strength_is_never_lear: A chew cannot touch what its batch does not see.
stable_exactly_below_two_over_strength: Gives the largest learning rate at which a chew converges at all: below two over the largest kernel strength of the batch.
size_of_error_along_a_direction_after_ma: The exact error left along a direction after k steps on the same batch.
residual_after_many_steps_is_a_sum_over_: The error on a batch after k steps of a chew, as a formula.
loss_after_many_steps_is_a_sum_over_dire: The loss on a batch after k steps of a chew, as a formula.
travel_is_at_most_residual_over_root_of_: Bounds the travel of a chew by the batch's error over the root of its weakest kernel strength. With the forgetting ceiling, forgetting is bounded by things that can be measured.
output_moves_at_most_length_times_distan: A short chew changes the answers elsewhere only a little.
fit_near_the_start_is_tame_everywhere: A short chew changes the answers elsewhere only a little.
split_fit_fits_signal_and_noise: The risk, as a theorem: a fit to convergence fits the noise of its data exactly. A chew does this to its batch.
noise_damage_at_a_new_input_is_at_most_i: A cap on what the fitted noise of one batch does at a new input.
clipping_caps_the_travel: Clipping would cap the travel of a chew, and with it the forgetting.
